task.title: Split source-grep implementation into focused tool-local modules
task.problem: The PR #6 source_grep.py module combines roughly 3,260 lines of CLI, private APIs, cache traversal, origins, output, mounts and concurrent searches.
task.proposal: Extract cohesive tool-local modules and backend orchestration, keep the public command/module entry point, document ownership and move tests to the owning module boundaries.
acceptance: Console and python -m entry points keep their CLI and exit-status contracts; help works without BuildStream installed.
Both search backends preserve result ordering, output formats, partial errors, cache format and cleanup behavior.
Existing regression and supported-version integration suites still pass; add focused cross-module contract coverage.
Document module responsibilities and resource ownership; avoid circular application/backend imports.
evidence: Branch refactor/source-grep-modules, based on PR #6 head 12d883f130eb3f62e69976581f8819cbe11b6c5e.
109 non-integration tests passed locally, including 21 new cross-module contract cases; 71 extracted functions/classes retain identical ASTs after resolving module qualifiers.
